{{Top|leg}}
A '''microcomputer''' was a small [[Computer/Legends|computer]] that could be installed in [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] set of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] included a microcomputer.
